title: Hiding Banner Ads On a Specific Static Page
text:
## Hiding Banner Ads On a Specific Static Page
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000054624
If ads have been set up on the website but need to be hidden on a specific static page for members, follow the steps below.
Navigate to My Content > Web Page Builder . Select the page where the ads should be hidden and click "Edit" :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12172533754/original/DivPVw-xW8tiDIQae20qKLSnoNedIoCzag.png?1767033671 | alt: ]
Click Page Options and select Hide Banner Ad Modules .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12172536483/original/p9ECU3OJsbYg3kDEg1ef0bP3xR6hm_medw.png?1767036841 | alt: ]
